verdict.rationale: The docs name Gusto, Rippling and other payroll/HR systems, plus HubSpot and Salesforce, as connectors that feed Ari's planning. Payroll data lands in the same live model as ledger actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet, with nightly refresh and sync controls. Missing for 10: documentation of which headcount and pipeline fields are imported and how they map into the model, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the HRIS/CRM syncs.
